# type: tile
# size: 16x16
# light: upper-left
# The ground the whole field set sits on.
# Two things keep the repeat from reading as a lattice. The tufts are not all
# the same shape - some are 2px dashes, one is a 2px upright blade, and the one
# on row 7 is split across the left and right edges so it only completes when
# the tile is laid next to itself. And the spacing is uneven, because evenly
# spaced marks line up into rows and columns once the field is laid out. See
# the README for what the first two attempts looked like.
# map: g=grass_base a=grass_hi s=grass_shadow
